Previous decision added -Dmaven.test.skip=true to suppress test dependency resolution, but the re-executed build still fails identically: netty-codec cannot resolve io.netty:netty-transport:jar:tests:4.1.118.Final-SNAPSHOT. The root cause is that mvn compile never produces test-jar artifacts, yet netty-codec declares a test-scoped dependency on netty-transport's test-jar. -Dmaven.test.skip=true did not prevent Maven from attempting to resolve this <type>test-jar</type> dependency within the reactor. No remaining approved action (set Java/Maven/Ant home, heap tuning, clean, or additional build args) can fix this reactor-internal test-jar resolution gap.
